literal_meaning: আঙুল ফুলে কলাগাছ হওয়া (finger swells up to become a banana tree)
figurative_meaning_bn: হঠাৎ বড়লোক; হঠাৎ প্রচুর ধনসম্পত্তির মালিক
figurative_meaning_en: Suddenly becoming rich; suddenly becoming the owner of abundant wealth and property
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে লটারি জিতে আঙুল ফুলে কলাগাছ হয়ে গেছে।
ব্যবসায় সফলতার পর তার জীবন আঙুল ফুলে কলাগাছের মতো বদলে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He won the lottery and suddenly became rich like a finger swelling into a banana tree.
After business success, his life transformed dramatically, swelling from humble beginnings to great wealth.
note: The idiom uses hyperbolic imagery of natural growth to depict rapid wealth accumulation, common in Bengali oral traditions.
